title: Show if
description: Shows part of a form only while another field has a given value: a phone number when Phone is chosen, a second address when a box is ticked, a text box for Other. Hidden, its fields don't submit and their required can't block the form. Starts in the right state after a failed submit, and works inside Livewire components.

consider.note: Hidden fields are disabled, so the browser doesn't send them, but a request can send any field anyway. Enforce the condition on the server: `required_if:` for a field the choice makes required, and for a value sent when the condition is false, decide: `exclude_unless:` drops it from the validated data, as the example does, or `prohibited_unless:` refuses the form.
